# hermes_status (Data Source)

Reads non-secret Hermes dashboard and gateway status. An optional `profile` scopes the status request.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `profile` (String) Optional Hermes profile to scope the status request.

### Read-Only

- `active_agents` (Number)
- `active_sessions` (Number)
- `auth_flows` (List of String)
- `auth_providers` (List of String)
- `auth_required` (Boolean)
- `gateway_busy` (Boolean)
- `gateway_drainable` (Boolean)
- `gateway_running` (Boolean)
- `gateway_state` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `overall` (String)
- `release_date` (String)
- `version` (String)
